title: feat(nm2sreadz): neighbor-read of 1-in 2-out split at t+1 on two-axis opposite z-probes: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: Neighbor-read of the UNSIGNED 1-in-2-out axis assignment on opposite z-probes: HOLD at all four. Carries the band's strongest locality statement in its discriminator section - neighbor-read of signed M fails at A, of signed O fails at B,C,D, and signed (M,O) joint set equality fails at EVERY z-probe, while the unsigned axis shadow is recovered at all four. I recomputed this host-wide: joint signed
